title: Dead gunman in Alberta police shootout a religious zealot
article: A local business owner has been identified as the deceased man involved in a shootout in downtown St. Paul, Alta., on Friday. John Carlos Quadros was the owner of HealthMart 2000, a local health food store with, according to its website, a mandate to provide "Herbs and Natural products given to us by GOD."
Quadros, 55, and his wife ran the store for over 15 years. The store is run out of a house just off 50 Avenue in the heart of downtown St. Paul.

In the policies/statements section of the store's website, concerns are raised regarding laws passed by the government to control access to natural health products, claiming they are "protecting the various agendas of the Big Billion dollar Corporations even if it means the suffering and death of countless numbers. May GOD protect you and the TRUTH set You FREE."

In the fall of 2013, Quadros made local headlines regarding his vocal opposition of a Town of St. Paul proposal that would impose a mandatory chamber membership fee when applying for a business licence.

"I believe it's a moral and ethical violation that the chamber thinks it can force our hand to become members," Quadros told the St. Paul Journal on Sept. 18, 2013. Other business owners jumped to the side of Quadros in fighting the proposal.
St. Paul Mayor Glenn Andersen said at the time that he heard the complaints and said "he had some valid points."
